_note: Sovereign-scheduler overlay: this node schedules and computes over its operator's own processes and exposes no gateway surface. Client-side routing sends gateway operations to public infrastructure; only scheduling and compute for the node's own processes terminate here.
_note-confirmation-depth: Pinned explicitly rather than inherited: the node default of 10 blocks is conservative for a scheduler serving only its own processes, and production deployments run 3 to shorten assignment finality. Raise it if your processes cannot tolerate deeper reorgs.
_note-header-workers: Phone-scale: keep header workers small (2-8) so scheduler sync does not starve the runtime on mobile SoCs.
